_comment: Paste the config from Firebase Console → Project settings → General → Your apps → SDK setup and configuration. Leave a value empty until you have it. vapidKey is the Web Push certificate key pair (Project settings → Cloud Messaging → Web configuration). Use this same Firebase project for android/app/google-services.json, ios/Runner/GoogleService-Info.plist, and KumPay-backend/firebase-service-account.json.
